entries.text: Kiki! What in the world do you think you’re\ndoing?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_01

entries.text: You knew that the ogre wasn’t the real bad\nguy in the stories...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_03

entries.text: The Loyal Three were the real bad guys, but the\nogre’s the one that gets treated like an outcast![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_04

entries.text: And you two did the same thing to me![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_05

entries.text: You treated ME like an outcast when you went\nan’ met with the ogre![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_06

entries.text: You’re no different than those villagers back\nthen...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_07

entries.text: You know how much I love the ogre![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_08

entries.text: You acted like you didn’t know anything, but you\nwere laughing at me behind my back all along![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_09

entries.text: That’s not what happened at all![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_04

entries.text: If you win, I’ll give you back the mask.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_12

entries.text: I’m not gonna hold anything back, you hear me![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_17

entries.text: Kieran returned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Teal Mask[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to you!
entries.label: sdc01_0320_system_02

entries.text: You put the Teal Mask in your Bag’s [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Key Items[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\npocket.
entries.label: sdc01_0320_system_03

entries.text: Say hi to the ogre for me.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_brother_22

entries.text: Hey, listen, Kiki... I should apologize for—[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_08

entries.text: I’m sorry about all that. He’s normally not like\nthis at all.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_09

entries.text: Do you think most people act up like that around\nKieran’s age?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_10

entries.text: The way he’s acting is a bit scary, honestly...\nIs that just me, or did you feel it too?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_11

entries.text: I sure never let teenage angst get to my head\nlike that. I don’t know what to do with him...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_13

entries.text: Hey, can you hear something? ...Is it coming from\nthe Loyal Three Monument?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0320_sister_14
